name: NGX equities API — listed companies (OPEN)
note: OPEN. GET ?market=&sector=&orderby=&pageSize=500&pageNo=0 -> JSON array of listed equities: Symbol, Sector, Market (board), prices, Volume, Value, TradeDate. Verified live: 146 equities (DANGCEM, MTNN, GTCO, ZENITHBANK, SEPLAT...). Listed-company financial statements/disclosures also on ngxgroup.com.

name: CAC company search / documents (Cloudflare-gated + PAID)
note: Official registry (RC/BN/IT). Public search Cloudflare-gated ('Just a moment'); documents (status report/certified extract/annual returns/AFS) paid via the CAC portal. No open bulk/API. Do not bypass Cloudflare/paywall. Redact directors/shareholders (NDPA 2023).

name: CAC Beneficial Ownership Register (PSC) — token-gated API
note: Public beneficial ownership register (Persons With Significant Control). API borapp.cac.gov.ng/api/bor-search/get_psc (POST) requires an access token. Do NOT bypass the token gate. Beneficial owners are personal data (NDPA 2023) — redact. NOTE: a token-less /auth/access-token endpoint leaked an individual's PII (misconfiguration) — do not use/store.
